name: The Verdant Reach
subtitle: Roots of the first world
lore: The first world, where the Planes took root. Its groves still drink from the leylines under Moonhaven, and its Guardians were keepers of the old trees before the Void taught them to hunt.

effects.name: Verdant Bloom
effects.text: 2 new event tiles spawn at each turn end. Board caps: Sentinel 4, Cursed obelisk 3, Rune merchant 3, Mana fountain 4, Rune shrine 1.

effects.name: Lucky Path
effects.text: Each cleared event tile: 15% chance of +1 dice roll.

name: Sands of the Eclipse
subtitle: Ruins beneath twin suns
lore: Two suns rose here and never set. The cities they burned lie under the dunes, and their Guardians still keep watch over doors no one remembers opening.

effects.name: Shifting Sands
effects.text: 3 new event tiles spawn at each turn end; Sentinel cap 5.

effects.name: Scorching Sun
effects.text: Danger +5% at each turn end.

effects.name: Mirage
effects.text: Minigame time −10%.

effects.name: Desert Bounty
effects.text: Card rewards +10%. 10% chance of +1 dice roll.

name: The Astral Glacier
subtitle: Frozen skies, wakeful souls
lore: A sky froze as it fell and became a land of ice. The souls caught inside do not sleep; they wait for a Warden warm enough to wake them, or to join them.

effects.name: Frozen Time
effects.text: Minigame time −15%.

effects.name: Glacial Toll
effects.text: Portals cost 4 energy.

effects.name: Biting Cold
effects.text: Danger +5% at each turn end; failed minigame: Danger +15%.

effects.name: Crystal Hoard
effects.text: Card rewards +20%. 10% chance of +1 dice roll.

name: Emberfall Dominion
subtitle: Realm of eternal embers
lore: A kingdom that chose to burn rather than kneel to the Void. Its fires have not gone out in a thousand years, and its iron knights still guard the ashes of their king.

effects.name: Ashfall
effects.text: 3 new event tiles spawn at each turn end; Sentinel cap 6, Cursed obelisk 4.

effects.name: Searing Ground
effects.text: Danger +8% at each turn end; failed minigame: Danger +15%.

effects.name: Heat Haze
effects.text: Minigame time −15%; portals cost 4 energy.

effects.name: Molten Spoils
effects.text: Card rewards +35%. 10% chance of +1 dice roll.

name: Crown of the Void
subtitle: Throne at the edge of darkness
lore: Where the Planes end, the dark wears a crown. Every Guardian that falls below finds its way to this throne, and the throne sends it back stronger.

effects.name: Void Hunger
effects.text: At each turn end the void eats 1 unvisited event tile.

effects.name: Dread Tide
effects.text: Danger +10% at each turn end; failed minigame: Danger +20%.

effects.name: Collapsing Time
effects.text: Minigame time −20%; portals cost 4 energy.

effects.name: Abyssal Reward
effects.text: Card rewards +50%. 8% chance of +1 dice roll.

name: The Scarlet Rift
subtitle: Where the five seals bleed
lore: The five seal stones were cut from one rock. Where they crack, the Planes bleed into each other, and every Guardian that fell below rises here once more, red and unforgiving.

effects.name: Shifting Seals
effects.text: Each floor wears a random Plane 1-5: its ground, Guardian and arena, stained red.

effects.name: Borrowed Law
effects.text: Each floor also takes the effects of a random Plane 1-5, rolled apart from its look.

effects.name: Blood Tide
effects.text: Each floor starts at Danger +50%.

effects.name: Riftborn
effects.text: Guardians from floor 1 as strong as Plane 5 floor 25, and growing.
